title: Doppler effect for sound
design_rationale: Connect source motion to wavefront spacing before applying the moving-source frequency expression.
concepts_taught: Explain how source motion changes wavefront spacing and observed frequency for a stationary observer.
Distinguish source frequency, observed frequency and wave speed in the medium.
Choose the denominator sign for an approaching or receding sound source.
Calculate observed frequency using the moving-source Doppler expression.

next_module_can_assume: Explain how source motion changes wavefront spacing and observed frequency for a stationary observer.
Choose the denominator sign for an approaching or receding sound source.
Calculate observed frequency using the moving-source Doppler expression.
next_module_must_not_assume: Order electromagnetic-spectrum regions or recall their wavelength ranges.
